_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
D awanek {player_id} deg Tic Tac Toe.
Taqsiṭ-ik d arbaɛ timsal di tɣarḍa (s asrir, s azrir neɣ s uɣirur) ɣef ubiru.
Deg wakud-ik, ilaq ad tferneḍ numru n takarḍa (0-8) i deg tebɣiḍ ad tessekneḍ azamul-ik.
Am medya, '[4]' ad yessekne azamul-ik deg tlemmast n ubiru.
D awanek {player_id}, ad tiliḍ '{symbol}', ma d umsaddaq-ik ad yili '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ahil-nni i d-tefkaḍ ur yeṭṭafar ara anagraw iṣeḥḥa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} mačči d tazeqqa tamegdayt. Ilaq ad yili gar 0 akked 8.
